description: The Regular clone after 16 generations of evolution strategies on the Aggressive objective against Bot: Rookie (the mean network after the last generation). ES's own validation did not prefer it over the clone, and on 30 fresh test matches it scored 83.4 vs the clone's 80.7 (paired difference +2.7, not significant): this short run demonstrates the pipeline, not a stronger fighter.
name: Regular Clone + ES (Aggressive)
